newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - CRA Managed started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - CRA Managed started.

text.p: -- Smith Barney analyst Brian Kearns said on Thursday he had started coverage of CRA Managed Care with a rating of buy.
-- CRA is in "a very large underpenetrated market providing managed care to the workers compensation insurance industry," Kearns told Reuters.
-- The Boston company has a history of earnings and revenue growth and was making an entrance into the auto injury insurance managed care market.
-- Kearns set a 12-month price target of $55 for the shares. They opened on Wednesday up 1/4 to 42-1/2.
